Similarly, the amount received by a football player through participating in a talk show to give tips ad clues for making maximum goals is an accessible income as it is received in the course of work. The $100 received by an employee on a regular basis as bonus is an accessible income as it is received in the course of work. However, a gift of $5000 received from a deceased relative is not an accessible income as it is not received in the course of work. Similarly, the amount received by a person for the private use of a private residence is not an accessible income as it is not received in the course of work. Growing vegetables in the kitchen garden of the house to sell the vegetables every Sunday in the nearby market is an accessible income as it is done in the course of business.
